review.notes: H3 video. The cannon fired in almost every take and the stomping walk pulsed the background dark on each step. The idle was retaken calm with a steady glow and a dark muzzle and comes back clean; the walk took three more tries with quiet gliding steps before one matted on every frame. The ranged and cast were retaken with a dark muzzle but still flashed once; the ranged holds the aim and snaps to the recoil, and the cast skips the flash at the top of the salute. The ram attack keeps the first take and snaps from the drawn-back stance to full lunge, skipping the muzzle flash. The defend skips its rejected plates. The walk loops on frames 35 to 93.
